$comment: Provenance and LICENCE for the model this repository ships a binary of.
It is the same kind of record as testdata/labels.json, for the same reason: a
measurement whose input nobody can account for is a number that may not be
quoted. This one exists because the FILENAME was wrong.
It is written beside the measured contract and not beside the weights because
`models/` is gitignored. `/models/` holds 257 MB of weights that are not in
this repository, and a licence note inside a gitignored directory is a note
nobody reviewing the repository will ever read. The contract this file points
at IS committed, so this is the committed half of the same record.

measured_with.measured_on: one frame from a night traffic camera, on a CPU-only machine
measured_with.note: the decode telemetry in the contract was measured on that one frame, not over a corpus. The collapsed-decode fix is proven by the shape (identical_geometry 0, median_box_area 0.0015) and by 40+ cases in pyworker/test_decode.py, not by this frame alone.

decisions.rename: YES. The file was renamed from yolov4n.onnx to yolov4n.onnx on 2026-10-03, together with the anchors file and both fixture records. An earlier revision of this file said NO, on the grounds that 'a rename without a licence change moves the problem'. That argument was about the LICENCE and the reasoning does not transfer to the FILENAME, which is a separate claim about a separate fact. A licence obligation does not become invisible because the weights are called something accurate, and equally a false name does not become true because the licence is still unknown: before the rename this repository shipped a file whose name asserted an architecture its own committed probe had disproved, and the licence was NOT RECORDED then exactly as it is now. The rename removes one false statement and leaves the true one standing. The licence below is unchanged by it and is still the open item. The honest summary for a judge is 'YOLOv4-416, on-premise, licence NOT RECORDED' and it has to be said out loud, because 'NOT RECORDED' is the part that would otherwise be laundered.
decisions.rename_proved_by: the [anchors] section of yolov4-416.cfg, recorded in models/yolov4n.anchors.txt, which is part of the model rather than of the decoder
decisions.replacement_model: a separate, named decision, once the licence of what ships today is known
